Play the story "New Game: Pretty+ — The Hero, Reset to Cute" here : https://infiniteworlds.app/shared/g2mtU9

Sir Aldric was the kingdom's Lv. 99 hero — undefeated, unbreakable, unstoppable. Then he stormed the tower of the Enchantress of Ribbons, and with her last breath of mana she cast her signature curse: Ribbonfall! Now he's back to Lv. 1, his armor turned into a frilly pink battle dress, his greatsword shrunk to something heart-shaped, and his class rewritten into something unbearably cute. Worse, the curse rewired how he grows: brute force earns almost nothing, but charm, grace and being adored level him up fast. Every level makes him stronger — and the curse deeper. Climb back to Lv. 99. Just don't ask what you'll look like when you get there.
